Name: Ammizabad, Son of Benaiah
Summary: Son of Benaiah, in his father's course of the third month.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:6: Son of Benaiah, in his father's course of the third month.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ammizabad stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
